# Proposed ADR — bounded Claude technical qualification before V1

Review copy for explicit maintainer approval. The authoritative ADR identifier
and status come from the Foundry tracker lifecycle. Related issue: PAT-16.
No runtime promotion or native campaign is authorized before explicit approval.

## Context

PAT-14 is delivered and PAT-15's Codex migration is delivered at base
`ee035f7b2cfcce4f9f272afede2b4510d54d5e9a`. Accepted PAT-ADR-0010 v0003 permits
only the urgent Codex exception; its text and proofs are not modified here.
The maintainer's V1 scope decision includes PAT-16 but explicitly requires
approval of the concrete Claude contract before governed implementation or native
qualification. FOUNDRY-ADR-0006/0008/0013/0015/0018/0019 remain authoritative
outside the narrow amendment below.

Coordinator preflight on 3 October 2026 initially found Claude Code 2.1.267.
The normal Homebrew upgrade completed; the actual binary
`/opt/homebrew/bin/claude` reads 2.1.285. It clears the documented client
minimums; this is compatibility evidence, not model execution qualification.
Auth reports claude.ai, firstParty, Pro. Foundry source manifest is 0.9.0;
actual native loaded Foundry version remains unknown. No native qualification
call has been made. Version and identity must be read again before execution.

Fable 5.1 is not included on Pro: usage credits apply from the first request.
The zero-credit envelope cannot call it. See the official
plan billing rule : https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15424964-claude-fable-models-on-your-plan.
Claude Code also permits non-interactive Fable billing without a consent prompt;
`-p` is not a spending guard. See
model configuration : https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config.

## Proposed decision

Extend PAT-ADR-0010's urgent V1 technical exception to Claude in PAT-16 only,
and amend FOUNDRY-ADR-0006/0008 mappings and ADR-0019's economic prerequisite
only to allow an explicitly approved technical Claude promotion after the
checks below, before PAT-17. This does not claim cheaper usage, general capability,
full cross-host qualification or completion of PAT-17. Codex mappings, authority,
budgets, paid-comparison envelope and historic proofs remain unchanged.

Freeze the proposed contract
pat-16-claude-technical-contract-v1.json : pat-16-claude-technical-contract-v1.json
and its digest with the human decision. Frozen contract file SHA-256:
`8aa613503dbf04326d6c01e011d9dedef21c21036932be2577624a922df3fb78`. Ticket candidates are:

| Role / tier | Explicit transmitted model | Effort | Current constraint |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lupin / economy | `claude-haiku-4-5` | not applicable, omitted | Qualification pending |
| Eiffel / balanced | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | medium | Qualification pending |
| Maigret / frontier | `claude-opus-5-5` | high | Qualification pending |
| Vauban / apex | `claude-fable-5-1` | high | Blocked: Pro requires credits |

Concrete decision proposed for acceptance: qualify the Pro zero-credit V1
tranche with Vauban / apex = `claude-opus-5-5` / high. Keep apex tier and
architect high floor; this is an explicit limited mapping amendment, not a
demotion to frontier. Fable 5.1 remains the ticket's original candidate but is
excluded from V1 native qualification on this Pro account. The JSON slots freeze
this exact proposed alternative. It is recommended, not selected, authorized or
promoted until the maintainer explicitly accepts this ADR and contract digest.

If the maintainer declines this branch, apex stays blocked/unqualified and the
contract must be revised and frozen before any dispatch. No Fable probe,
replacement call, added slot, subscription migration or paid Fable authority is
included. Paid Fable would require a separate authority and different envelope.

At most four native Claude host sessions, one per role, twenty minutes per
session, zero qualification retries, zero API/additional usage credits. The real
Agent path entails up to eight native contexts (four parents plus four
children), all calls and tokens counted within those four slots. The parent is
Sonnet 5.5/medium, with included access verified, at most two turns and exactly
one intended Foundry Agent dispatch. No extra orchestration session, preparatory
model probe, resume, autonomous delegation or uncounted retry is allowed. This
Claude budget is separate from the already delivered Codex campaign.

Qualification must exercise the native Claude Agent boundary with Foundry
routing hook, capability profiles, permissions, effort frontmatter and normal
review claims. Four ordinary `-p` prompts merely named after roles are insufficient.
`--agent` selects a current-session role and alone does not prove the Agent-tool
hook. CLI help establishes available interfaces, not their actual execution.
The supported subagent contract : https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
allows explicit IDs; all version/provider behavior still needs bounded evidence.
`--bare` is excluded because it disables OAuth/hooks and uses API access.

Before any dispatch, pass deterministic tests at exact candidate SHA, validate
statics and their verifiers, and freeze the first eligible normal PAT-16 PR
head observed after preflight starts: PR URL, immutable base/head, diff digest,
AC/ADR/contract digests, test commands/results and deterministic reviewer claim.
No new head or different corpus may be selected after a smoke result. Reuse exact
PAT-14 static packets/verifiers 1/2/4; static 4 reasons about the original enumerated
Codex proposal and is only an invariant task, not a Claude quality benchmark.
The frontier slot is the normal independent blank-context PAT-16 review of the
frozen real diff; its terminal BLOCK is execution evidence, never delivery success.

Requested route, transmitted parameters and native observed child identity/effort
must be distinct. No plan, model self-description, agent name, family-only display
or Foundry-generated receipt proves executed identity. Missing exact identity or
effective effort remains unavailable. Haiku explicitly transmits no effort;
historical low records retain legacy requested intent without claiming supported
execution. Old full pins are never silently changed to latest aliases. Override,
allowlist, cap, provider refusal and safety fallback diagnostics preserve floors;
substitution is not successful qualification and cannot justify another call.

Collect actual parent/child tokens after completion through the explicit offline
ADR-0015 reader; missing counters remain null/unavailable, never planned tokens or
zero. Preserve ADR-0008 passive telemetry privacy and fail-open behavior. Qualification
digests stay in existing qualification artifacts, not passive telemetry. No evidence
store redesign, raw-log upload or credential copying is introduced.

## Promotion, rollback and delivery

Implementation remains blocked until this ADR/contract including this explicit apex amendment are approved.
Then deterministic tests, authorized bounded native results, independent review,
exact-SHA CI through both sources, and verified rollback precede any explicit human
Claude promotion decision. Permissions, blank review, turn/packet caps, escalation
rules and reviewer/architect floors stay intact; neither ultra nor ultracode is enabled.
Each provider/client not tested stays unqualified. A changed final head requires
ordinary fresh review and CI; a frozen smoke proof does not certify later diffs.

Freeze and verify restoration of original Claude defaults/profiles and explicit
operator pins at the candidate base. On regression or identity/effort/billing
uncertainty, stop new launches and retain/restore incumbent through the normal
reviewed path. An unsupported incumbent remains diagnosed unavailable, never guessed.
Personal overrides and the primary session model are not changed automatically.

PAT-61 consumes exact source-mode Claude evidence and unresolved affected cells;
PAT-62 retains official post-installation/upgrade readback after release. Source
plugin loading is not an official installation. Both stages remain distinct.

## Documentation status and limits

These two proposal documents are updated. Current runtime, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md R7,
CLI/config/model vocabularies and skill surfaces are unchanged in step 0, so current
behavior docs require no implementation update yet. The approved implementation
must update model-routing/migration notes per touched surface, and copy any R7 edit
byte-identically into CLAUDE.md. No unshipped documentation gate is claimed.

Alternatives rejected: promotion from announcements alone; silent alias migration;
paid Fable hidden behind `-p`; reusing Codex receipts as Claude proof; expanding the
smoke into a PAT-17 benchmark. Unavailable evidence normally retains the incumbent.
The proposal author cannot accept this ADR, authorize its own native campaign or
select the maintainer's apex alternative.
